name: Relase of Sep 14, 2026
body:
User visible changes:
- trash-restore now trusts a shared trash directory (.Trash/$uid) with the
  same rule as trash-put/trash-list (sticky bit, non-symlink), instead of an
  unreliable uid comparison (curious-rabbit)
  [693f568, cee9ab1, e47ac5b, b1cf321]
- Prevented trash-restore from restoring a file outside the trash volume when
  a .trashinfo's Path= contains a path-traversal sequence (curious-rabbit)
  [6cd261c, d9e1a38]
- Sanitized control characters in filenames before printing them to a
  terminal, blocking ANSI escape injection via trash-list (curious-rabbit,
  Andrea Francia) [c6f260c, f2f3a17, 183b2cc, ba41913, a437d64]
- Hardened trash-put against unwritable trash directories: no more infinite
  retry loop on EACCES/ENOSPC/EROFS, refuses option-shaped filenames, refuses
  a symlinked info/files (curious-rabbit, Andrea Francia)
  [e62b15d, 6f8e489, b5119db, f03e96c]
- Homebrew install instructions (zai1208) [b696d31]
- Added arguments to the trash-restore man page (Andrew Davis) [dba2afa]
- Fixed a typo in the README (Tim Stewart) [e5732ba]
- Fixed syntax errors in the README, synced the Chinese README with the
  English one (Andy Wade) [673552d]
- Documented that trash-cli does not support BTRFS [abec42a]
Work on the tools:
- Split trashcli/fs.py into trashcli/fslib/ (abstract interfaces + real
  implementations) [bba948d]
- Refactored janitor.py and either.py, removed fs_func in favor of fakeable
  classes in tests [5ca895f, 98d9405, b032e47]
- Refactored the restore filesystem classes
  [2751f55, 5138296, 583eae4, 06089bd, 32b4e9f]
- Moved Python 2.7 testing out of tox into scripts/py27/, assorted Python 2.7
  / mypy compatibility fixes
  [921a074, 89835b1, 7c7e64f, 2b86d02, 40e21b7, 959cd7f, and ~10 more]
- Replaced parameterized with built-in pytest functionality
  (Benjamin A. Beasley) [6a0884e]
- Used unittest.mock from the stdlib instead of an external dependency
  (Eli Schwartz) [73e5892]
- Relaxed the virtualenv version requirement (David Auer) [864b13e]
- Made tests independent of filesystem directory-listing order
  [d2416d5, e0165ee]
- Cache the built Python 2.7 interpreter in CI [60d7fdf]
- Cleaned up dependencies in setup.cfg [05a8298, 2506628, bd83d57]

Note: a fix to preserve raw bytes of non-UTF-8 filenames in a .trashinfo's
Path= (SOV710) was merged [e361439, 0ded2af] and then reverted the same day
[2c69ac4, 4b1b3a7] with no reason given -- not included in this release, the
underlying bug is still present.
